name: Blade of Dawn — Kira Figure
description: A highly detailed 1/8 scale PVC figure of Kira Yoshikawa in mid-battle pose, with interchangeable sword parts.

name: Skybound Chronicles — Logo Tee
description: Soft cotton t-shirt with the Skybound Chronicles emblem screen-printed on the front. Available in three colors.

name: Phantom Academy — Plush Mascot
description: A soft 20cm plush of the Phantom Academy ghost mascot. Surface washable. Suitable for ages 3 and up.

name: Starlight Rhapsody — Enamel Pin Set
description: A set of four enamel pins featuring the Starlight Rhapsody characters in chibi style. Rubber pin backs included.

name: Starfall Protocol — Commander Hoodie
description: A heavyweight fleece hoodie with the Starfall Protocol mission patch embroidered on the chest. Unisex sizing.

name: Neon Reverie — Echo Collectible
description: A limited-edition translucent collectible figure of Echo with a light-up LED base. Numbered to 2,000 units.

name: Hollow Trail — Survival Tee
description: A heather gray t-shirt with the Hollow Trail survival guide print on the back. Made from recycled cotton blend.

name: Crown of Ashes — Keychain Set
description: A set of three metal keychains featuring the shattered blade reforged in different styles from the game.

name: Dune: Part Two — Arrakis Fremen Tee
description: Official 100% heavyweight cotton tee featuring the iconic Dune desert sandworm and Shai-Hulud geometric sigil.

name: The Batman — Gotham City Vengeance Tee
description: Distressed vintage-wash graphic t-shirt featuring Robert Pattinson's Batmobile blueprints and emblem.

name: The Batman — Collector's 1/6 Scale Figure
description: Articulated collectible figure with die-cast Batarangs, grapple gun, LED chest armor, and fabric wired cape.

name: Oppenheimer — 70mm Film Cell Collector Plaque
description: Numbered museum-grade display containing an authentic 70mm physical film cell from Christopher Nolan's Trinity sequence.

name: The 12th Precinct — Badge Replica
description: A screen-accurate metal replica of the detective badge from the show, presented in a display case with stand.

name: The Hollow University — Logo Hoodie
description: A charcoal hoodie with the Hollow University crest in gold embroidery. Heavyweight cotton blend for cold evenings.

name: Long Way Home — Guitar Pick Necklace
description: A necklace featuring a guitar pick pendant inspired by Trip's signature pick from the show. Stainless steel chain.

name: District 7 — Plush Companion
description: A plush version of the mysterious cat that appears in every episode of District 7. Approximately 15cm tall.

name: Eclipse — Midnight Album (Photobook Ver.)
description: The new album in photobook format, including a 120-page photobook, CD, random photocard, and foldout poster.

name: Wildflower — Light Stick Ver. 3
description: The official Wildflower light stick, updated with Bluetooth-synced color changing and a new flower-bud design.

name: Northern Lights — Tour Hoodie
description: Official tour hoodie with the Northern Lights World Tour dates printed on the back. Oversized fit.

name: Eclipse — Mini Plush Keychain
description: A mini plush keychain of the Eclipse group mascot. Soft finish with a sturdy metal clip. Collect all seven.

name: Guardline — The Sentinel Bust
description: A resin bust statue of The Sentinel, hand-painted and numbered. Limited edition of 1,500. Approximately 18cm tall.

name: The Fracture — Graphic Novel Vol. 1
description: The first collected volume of The Fracture, hardcover with 280 pages and exclusive cover art. Signed bookplate included.

name: Iron Coast — Noir City Tee
description: A black t-shirt with Jack Brass's silhouette against the Iron Coast skyline. Screen-printed with a soft-touch finish.

name: Guardline — Nova Star Enamel Pin
description: A hard enamel pin of Nova Star's light-burst emblem. Gold metal finish with two rubber pin backs.

name: Ronin's Path — Haruki Figure
description: A detailed figure of Haruki Sendo in traveling attire with katana drawn. Approximately 22cm tall with display base.

name: The Tea Shop on Cherry Lane — Manga Vol. 1-3 Box Set
description: A slipcased box set of the first three volumes with an exclusive booklet of behind-the-scenes sketches and author notes.

name: Shadow Boxer — Hoodie
description: A black pullover hoodie with the Shadow Boxer wrap-around print. Midweight cotton fleece with kangaroo pocket.

name: The Apothecary's Daughter — Plush Fox
description: A plush version of Sakura's fox companion from the manga. Soft faux-fur exterior with embroidered features. 25cm long.
